# WEALTHMETER.XYZ

> Evidence-led calculators and analysis for wealth distribution, net worth, income, financial resilience, and long-horizon planning.

## Start here

- [Global Wealth Rank Calculator](https://wealthmeter.xyz/): Compare net worth with global wealth-distribution models.
- [Longform Analysis](https://wealthmeter.xyz/longform.html): Research-led personal-finance and wealth analysis.
- [Wealth Briefs](https://wealthmeter.xyz/wealth-briefs.html): Curated data and research updates.
- [Methodology](https://wealthmeter.xyz/methodology.html): Model assumptions, limits, and interpretation.
- [Data Sources](https://wealthmeter.xyz/data-sources.html): Primary datasets and institutional sources.
- [Reports](https://wealthmeter.xyz/reports.html): WealthMeter research reports.
- [Partners and Publishers](https://wealthmeter.xyz/partners): Approved calculator distribution, underwriting, and portfolio opportunities.
- [Embed Our Tools](https://wealthmeter.xyz/embed-tools): Preview the Global Wealth Rank widget and request a domain-scoped installation.

## Core tools

- [Who Owns America? U.S. Wealth Atlas 2026](https://wealthmeter.xyz/us-wealth-atlas): Explore 36 years of Federal Reserve data on who owns U.S. household wealth, what each wealth group holds, and how aggregate wealth differs by age.
- [Wealth Horizon](https://wealthmeter.xyz/wealth-horizon): Test long-term portfolio scenarios with explicit assumptions for contributions, returns, volatility, inflation, fees, and estimated tax drag.
- [Live Better for Less](https://wealthmeter.xyz/live-better-for-less.html): Find lower-cost countries only after they pass a user-selected quality floor across health, essential services, connectivity, infrastructure, sanitation, and safety.
- [Lifestyle Abroad](https://wealthmeter.xyz/lifestyle-abroad.html): Translate a household spending budget between national private-consumption price levels.
- [Purchasing Power Tools](https://wealthmeter.xyz/purchasing-power.html): Choose between quality-adjusted discovery and a specific country comparison.
- [Country Systems Atlas](https://wealthmeter.xyz/country-systems-atlas.html): Compare two or three countries across productive capacity, infrastructure, logistics, essential access, settlement, and longevity measures.
- [Net Worth Calibration](https://wealthmeter.xyz/networth.html)
- [Income Percentile](https://wealthmeter.xyz/income_ranker.html)
- [FIRE Timeline Planner](https://wealthmeter.xyz/fire_timeline.html)
- [Financial Runway Lab](https://wealthmeter.xyz/runway_lab.html)

## New Special Features

- [The Debt Map](https://wealthmeter.xyz/debt-map.html): Explore household debt by type, age and the 11 reported states, with a browser-only comparison of your debt mix.
- [Where Your Paycheck Ranks](https://wealthmeter.xyz/paycheck-rank.html): Compare income with Census distributions and BLS occupation wages, keeping people, full-time workers and households distinct.
- [Rent vs. Buy, By Metro](https://wealthmeter.xyz/rent-vs-buy.html): Compare renting and buying under your own costs, growth and return assumptions, using published housing context.
- [What Your Salary Is Really Worth](https://wealthmeter.xyz/salary-worth.html): Compare the salary equivalents implied by BEA regional price levels across states and metro areas.

## Citation guidance

Use the canonical page URL and retain each page's stated population, currency, date, and model assumptions. WealthMeter content is educational and is not financial advice.
